admission.title: Eligibility & Admission Criteria (DSE)
content: **Admission Score Formula**: Best 5 Subjects. Programme score considers Category A subjects and may include Mathematics Extended Module 1 or 2 or Category C subject whichever is higher. Median 28, Lower Quartile 26, Upper Quartile 28 (2025 admission scores).
**Core Subjects Minimum Level**: Chinese Language 3, English Language 3, Mathematics (Compulsory Part) 2, Citizenship and Social Development Attained (same as HKU general entrance requirements).

**Elective Subjects**: ANY 1 SUBJECT (excluding Applied Learning, Other Language) at Level 3, PLUS ANY 1 SUBJECT (excluding Applied Learning) at Level 3; OR ANY 1 SUBJECT (excluding Applied Learning, Other Language) at Level 3 plus Mathematics Extended Module 1 or 2 at Level 3.

**Notes**: Other Language subjects will be used as unspecified elective subjects. Applied Learning subjects are not counted as electives but may be considered as supporting information. HKDSE score conversion: 5**=8.5, 5*=7, 5=5.5 (see admissions.hku.hk/apply/jupas).
**Interview**: Yes — on a selective basis (shortlisted candidates may be invited).
**2025 Application Statistics**: Band A 195 applicants, Total 2,121 applicants.
**2025 Offer Statistics (Main Round)**: 28 offers — all 28 to Band A applicants; 0 offers to Band B, C, D, or E.
**First Year Intake**: 35 places.
**Duration**: 4 years full-time.
**First Year Tuition**: HK$47,000 (UGC-funded).

curriculum.title: Programme Structure & Curriculum
content: **Programme Overview**: The Bachelor of Social Work (BSW) is a professionally oriented programme in the Department of Social Work and Social Administration (SWSA), Faculty of Social Sciences. Training leads to a professionally recognised qualification in social work practice.
**Year 1**: Foundation in social science theories plus HKU Common Core courses.
**Year 2**: Consolidation of social sciences knowledge into the social work discipline.
**Years 3–4**: Integration and specialisation — wide-ranging electives (e.g. vulnerable groups, specialised counselling approaches) and application of classroom learning in practice.
**Core areas**: Social welfare and social policy; specialised social work theory and practice; human behaviour and the social environment; research; law; sociology; and psychology.

**Practice learning**: Social work practice laboratory courses; advanced problem-based learning courses; **two supervised fieldwork placements** in local or overseas agencies (including a **10-week summer placement** between Years 3 and 4, plus a second placement in the final year).

**Curriculum scale**: 4-year programme (240 credits) with substantial professional social work core courses; graduates may apply for registration with the **Hong Kong Social Workers Registration Board** upon successful completion.

career.title: Career Pathways & Prospects
content: **Registered social work pathway**: The programme is recognised by the Hong Kong Social Workers Registration Board — graduates are eligible to apply for registration as a social worker.
**Public sector**: Careers such as **assistant social work officer** at the Hong Kong Social Welfare Department.
**Human services & NGOs**: Work in community organisations, not-for-profit associations, and human services locally and overseas.
**Broader sectors**: Some graduates also pursue roles in public relations, the police, education, business, and administration — though most alumni join the social work profession.
**Further studies**: Postgraduate study in social work, counselling, or related fields at HKU or other universities.

campus.title: Campus Life & Student Experience
content: **Faculty & department**: Department of Social Work and Social Administration, Faculty of Social Sciences, The University of Hong Kong. Contact: +852 3917 2097 / 3917 5014.
**Location**: HKU Main Campus, Pok Fu Lam — social sciences teaching and student facilities.
**Fieldwork & exchange**: Supervised local/overseas placements; some students undertake overseas exchange (e.g. one-semester study abroad) as part of their BSW journey.

**Student community**: Connect with the SWSA community and Faculty of Social Sciences student activities; Hong Kong University Social Work Alumni Association (HKUSWAA) supports graduates after completion.
**University resources**: HKU libraries, learning commons, counselling and wellness services available to all undergraduates.

competitiveness.title: Admission Competitiveness Analysis
content: **Overall Level**: High (★★★★☆). Median Best 5 score 28 (2025); selective among HKU programmes, with **selective interview** for shortlisted applicants.
**Score bands (2025, Best 5)**: Median 28 | Lower Quartile 26 | Upper Quartile 28. Aim at or above median for a realistic Band A chance.

**Band A competition (2025)**: 195 Band A applicants for 28 main-round offers (~14.4% of Band A applicants received an offer in the main round). All 28 offers went to Band A — **0 offers to Bands B–E**.
**Scale of applications**: 2,121 total applicants in 2025 — strong demand relative to first-year intake of 35 places; main-round offers (28) reflect selective admission.
**Interview factor**: Unlike JS6717 (BSocSc), BSW may invite shortlisted candidates for interview — prepare to articulate motivation for social work and relevant community experience.
**Differentiators**: Strong Best 5 score, Band A choice, solid core grades (English and Chinese at Level 3 minimum), meaningful OEA in community/social service, and interview readiness where invited.

alumni.title: Notable Alumni & Faculty
content: **Faculty network**: The Faculty of Social Sciences has **30,000+ alumni** worldwide; BSW graduates join the social work profession and the Hong Kong University Social Work Alumni Association (HKUSWAA).
**LAM Tsz-wing (BSW)**: Featured on Faculty Student Voices — describes empowering individuals, families and communities as a social work change-maker during four years at HKU BSW.
**TSUI Long-ying (BSW)**: Featured on Student Voices — highlights structured theory, policy and research learning blended with practice laboratory and placement support.
**CHOI Hiu Lam (BSW)**: Featured on Student Voices — gained international exposure through a one-semester exchange in Sweden alongside two field placements and elective specialisation.

**TANG Choi Lei (BSW)**: Featured on Student Voices — notes professional training across social work theory, welfare, policy and supervised local/international placements leading to Social Workers Registration Board eligibility.
**More stories**: Additional BSW graduate voices are published on the Faculty of Social Sciences Alumni Spotlight / Student Voices pages.

scholarships.title: Scholarships & Financial Aid
content: **HKU scholarships**: HKU offers a broad range of merit-based scholarships for local undergraduates, including support for top-ranking JUPAS students. The highest HKDSE scorers may receive awards covering full tuition and living expenses.
**Financial assistance**: Talented students experiencing financial difficulties may apply for additional financial assistance through HKU.
**Government aid**: Eligible local students may apply for TSFS and NLSFT/NLSPS through the Student Finance Office.

**Department & faculty awards**: Check the Department of Social Work and Social Administration and Faculty of Social Sciences websites for programme-specific scholarships and prizes updated each admissions cycle.

tips.title: Ace Sir's HKU BSW Strategy
content: **Score targeting**: Aim for **Best 5 ≥ 28** (2025 median). Minimum competitive floor around **LQ 26**; at **UQ 28** you align with the upper band for this programme.
**Band A is essential**: In 2025, **100% of main-round offers were Band A** — place JS6731 in Band A. Lower bands received zero offers in the main round.
**Interview preparation**: JUPAS lists interview on a selective basis — prepare to explain why social work matches your values, with examples from volunteering or community service.

**Subject mix**: Meet core minimums (Chi 3, Eng 3, Math 2, CSD Attained) and two electives at Level 3. M1/M2 can count toward electives per JUPAS rules — check https://admissions.hku.hk/apply/jupas for your combination.

**Backup programmes**: Consider **JS6717** (Bachelor of Social Sciences, median ~31) if you want broader social science exploration without professional social work registration; **JS6705** (Psychology) for people-focused study; **JS6810** only if your goal is the Government and Laws + LLB dual degree (separate programme, higher scores).
**OEA**: Document sustained community service, leadership in social welfare settings, or related experiences — highly relevant for BSW selection.
**Placement mindset**: Two fieldwork placements are core — show early interest in supervised practice in local or overseas agencies.

admission.title: 入學要求與計分詳情 (DSE)
content: **入學計分公式**：最佳五科。計分考慮甲類科目，並可計數學延伸部分（M1/M2）或丙類科目（以較高者為準）。中位數28分，下四分位數26分，上四分位數28分（2025年入學分數）。
**核心科目最低要求**：中國語文第3級、英國語文第3級、數學（必修部分）第2級、公民與社會發展科達標（與港大一般入學要求相同）。
**選修科目**：任何1科（不包括應用學習、其他語言）達第3級，另加任何1科（不包括應用學習）達第3級；或任何1科（不包括應用學習、其他語言）達第3級，加數學延伸部分（M1/M2）達第3級。
**備註**：其他語言科目將作為非指定選修科。應用學習科目不作選修計算，但可作輔助資料。文憑試計分換算：5**=8.5、5*=7、5=5.5（詳見 admissions.hku.hk/apply/jupas）。
**面試**：需要——按遴選基準邀請部分申請人。
**2025年申請統計**：Band A申請者195人，總申請者2,121人。
**2025年取錄統計（正選輪）**：取錄28人——全部28人均為Band A；Band B、C、D、E均為0人。
**修讀年期**：4年全日制。
**首年學費**：港幣47,000元（教資會資助）。

curriculum.title: 課程結構與內容
content: **課程概覽**：社會工作學士（BSW）由社會科學學院社會工作及社會行政學系（SWSA）開辦，為專業導向課程，畢業後可取得社會工作專業資格。
**第一年**：修讀社會科學理論基礎及港大共同核心課程。
**第二年**：將社會科學知識整合至社會工作專業。
**第三至四年**：整合與專修——多元選修（如不同弱勢社群、專業輔導取向）並把課堂學習應用於實務。
**核心範疇**：社會福利與社會政策；專業社會工作理論與實踐；人類行為與社會環境；研究；法律；社會學及心理學。
**實踐學習**：社會工作實踐實驗室課程；問題導向學習高級課程；**兩次專業督導下之實地實習**（包括**第三與第四年之間為期十週的暑期實習**，以及最後一年之第二次實習），可於本地或海外機構進行。
**課程規模**：四年制（240學分），以專業社會工作核心課程為主；完成課程後可向**香港社會工作者註冊局**申請註冊。

career.title: 職業前景與出路
content: **註冊社工出路**：課程獲香港社會工作者註冊局認可——畢業生合資格申請成為註冊社會工作者。
**公營部門**：如香港社會福利署**助理社會工作主任**等職位。
**社會服務及非政府機構**：於社區組織、非牟利機構及人本服務界別工作，亦可於海外發展。
**其他界別**：部分畢業生亦從事公共關係、警務、教育、工商及行政等工作——惟大多數校友投身社會工作專業。
**升學**：於本地或海外修讀社會工作、輔導或相關研究生課程。

campus.title: 校園生活與學生體驗
content: **學院及學系**：香港大學社會科學學院社會工作及社會行政學系。聯絡電話：+852 3917 2097／3917 5014。
**地點**：港大薄扶林主校園——社會科學教學及學生設施。
**實習及交流**：本地／海外專業督導下實習；部分學生於修讀期間參與海外交流（如一學期交換）。
**學生社群**：參與SWSA及社會科學學院活動；畢業後可透過香港大學社會工作校友會（HKUSWAA）與校友聯繫。
**大學資源**：圖書館、自修空間、輔導及身心健康服務。

competitiveness.title: 入學競爭力分析
content: **整體程度**：高（★★★★☆）。2025年最佳五科中位數28分；競爭激烈，並設**按遴選基準之面試**。
**分數區間（2025，最佳五科）**：中位數28｜下四分位數26｜上四分位數28。Band A宜達中位數或以上。
**Band A競爭（2025）**：195名Band A申請者競爭28個正選輪學額（約14.4% Band A申請者獲正選輪取錄）。**28個取錄全部為Band A**——Band B至E為0。
**申請規模**：2025年共2,121人申請；首年學額35人。正選輪取錄28人反映遴選嚴格。
**面試因素**：與JS6717（社會科學學士）不同，BSW可能邀請獲選申請人面試——須準備說明投身社會工作的動機及相關社區經驗。
**成功要素**：最佳五科成績、Band A選科、達標核心科目、與社會服務相關的OEA，以及面試準備（如獲邀）。

alumni.title: 知名校友及教職員
content: **學院校友網絡**：社會科學學院擁有**逾30,000名校友**；BSW畢業生投身社會工作專業，並可透過香港大學社會工作校友會（HKUSWAA）聯繫。
**林梓穎 LAM Tsz-wing（BSW）**：學院「學生分享」——在港大BSW四年間學習如何賦權個人、家庭及社區，成為社會改變者。
**徐朗盈 TSUI Long-ying（BSW）**：學院「學生分享」——強調理論、政策與研究學習，並結合實踐實驗室及實習支援。
**蔡曉霖 CHOI Hiu Lam（BSW）**：學院「學生分享」——曾於瑞典進行一學期交流，並完成兩次實地實習及選修專修。
**鄧彩麗 TANG Choi Lei（BSW）**：學院「學生分享」——述說專業培訓涵蓋社會工作理論、福利、政策及本地／國際實習，畢業後可向註冊局申請註冊。
**更多個案**：學院網站「校友聚焦／學生分享」載有更多BSW畢業生及在學生分享。

scholarships.title: 獎學金及經濟援助
content: **港大獎學金**：港大為本地本科生提供多項優異獎學金，包括予聯招成績優異者；最高成績考生可獲全額學費及生活費資助。
**經濟援助**：有經濟困難的優秀學生可申請港大額外經濟援助。
**政府資助**：合資格本地學生可申請專上學生資助計劃（TSFS）及免入息審查貸款計劃。
**學系及學院獎項**：請查閱社會工作及社會行政學系及社會科學學院網站最新獎學金資訊。

tips.title: Ace Sir 港大社會工作學士攻略
content: **分數目標**：最佳五科**≥28分**（2025中位數）。競爭下限約**下四分位26分**；達**上四分位28分**與2025上四分位一致。
**Band A必需**：2025年**正選輪取錄100%為Band A**——務必將JS6731放於Band A。
**面試準備**：聯招列明按遴選基準面試——準備說明為何選擇社會工作，並舉出義工或社區服務例子。
**選科組合**：達核心及兩科選修第3級要求。M1/M2可按聯招規則計入——詳查 https://admissions.hku.hk/apply/jupas 。
**後備課程**：**JS6717**（社會科學學士，中位數約31）若希望較廣泛探索社會科學；**JS6705**（心理學）若偏重人本學科；**JS6810**僅適用於有志修讀政治學與法學+法學士雙學位（分開課程、分數更高）。
**OEA**：記錄持續的社區服務、福利機構領導或相關經驗——與BSW收生高度相關。
**實習心態**：兩次實地實習為課程核心——及早展現對本地或海外督導下實務的興趣。
